definitions.gloss: to remove, to take off, to detach
definitions.explanation: To physically remove or separate something that was attached or installed.

examples.japanese: ドアのネジを{取|と}り{外|はず}してください。
examples.english: Please remove the screws from the door.

examples.japanese: エアコンを{取|と}り{外|はず}すには{専門業者|せんもんぎょうしゃ}に{頼|たの}んだほうがいい。
examples.english: You should hire a professional to remove the air conditioner.

examples.japanese: カバーを{取|と}り{外|はず}せば、{中|なか}が{見|み}える。
examples.english: If you remove the cover, you can see inside.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive). Intransitive pair: {取|と}り{外|はず}れる. Compound verb: {取|と}る + {外|はず}す. Pattern: Xを{取|と}り{外|はず}す (remove X).

ASPECT: ている indicates resulting state. {取|と}り{外|はず}してある = 'has been removed' (is in a removed state).

COMMON PATTERNS:
・ネジを{取|と}り{外|はず}す (remove screws)
・カバーを{取|と}り{外|はず}す (remove a cover)
・{部品|ぶひん}を{取|と}り{外|はず}す (remove parts)
・{簡単|かんたん}に{取|と}り{外|はず}せる (can be easily removed)

OPPOSITE: {取|と}り{付|つ}ける (to attach, to install).
